answer: Five jurors score the same delivery. Two scores differ by more than a point and the payment freezes, then the outlier's stake is slashed to the panel. Rewards leave as a vesting stream, not a lump. A receipt whose cipher fails to match on the second panel is rejected outright. An identity that stops submitting loses standing every epoch it sits idle, so parking a fake orchard of accounts costs real decay. The bridge from sock puppet to puppeteer has to fund both ends, and shared funding is exactly what the quorum checks.
